root_cause: Tool input/result handlers were installed only after useApp connected and React mounted the core. Eager initialization notifications could be missed, leaving the restore view empty before read_checkpoint ran.
qualification_limit: The initialization defect is reproduced through the actual built App/SDK. Exact message timing of the original native failure was not captured; final native render of the fixed artifact is still required.
fix: Register startup handlers with onAppCreated; hold only the latest input with partial/final status and the result, then replay through existing core handlers and release them.
